subject: hathaway-clinic
label: Twelve daughters, four sets of triplets, and two dartboards
from: Twelve daughters, nine born-affirmed and three born cis — and not one name
to: ALL TWELVE NAMED, in four sets of three, WITH THE NAMING METHOD FOR EACH SET
note:
ELDEST TRIPLETS — FREYA (S) · ARTEMIS (S) · HERA (F). MARIANNE'S CONTRIBUTION, named for goddesses.

SECOND TRIPLETS — AMY (F) · RAVEN (S) · COURTNEY (F).
THIRD TRIPLETS — JANE (S) · EMILY (S) · SUSAN (S).
THOSE TWO SETS WERE NAMED BY THROWING DARTS AT A BOARD. Marianne and Cassandra, six children, a dartboard. These are the names that landed.

YOUNGEST TRIPLETS — SERANA (S) · LYDIA (S) · AELA (S). CASSANDRA'S CONTRIBUTION, AFTER SPENDING THREE MONTHS PLAYING SKYRIM.

THE COUNT HOLDS: nine born shemale, three born female. Hera, Amy and Courtney are the three.

AND THE SHAPE OF THE NAMING IS THE MARRIAGE IN MINIATURE. Marianne named the first three after goddesses, deliberately, with meaning. Cassandra named the last three after a video game she had been playing for a quarter of a year. IN BETWEEN, FOR SIX CHILDREN, THEY THREW DARTS — which means they agreed to stop arguing about it and let the board decide, twice, and then lived with what it gave them.

Also on record: the clinic is owned by BOTH of them, jointly. See c-hathaway-hammer for what the Archive got wrong about the bar.
